title: Set Up: Make a Fossil Print

scenes.tts: You need modeling clay that does not harden, bought from a store. Gather things to press, such as shells, leaves, and a pinecone.
scenes.narration: You need modeling clay that does not harden, bought from a store. Gather things to press, such as shells, leaves, and a pinecone.

scenes.tts: Knead the clay until it is soft. Flatten it about two centimeters thick on a paper plate. Press each object straight down, then lift it straight up.
scenes.narration: Knead the clay until it is soft. Flatten it about two centimeters thick on a paper plate. Press each object straight down, then lift it straight up.

scenes.tts: Shells with ridges, leaves with thick veins, and toy feet with clear toes make the sharpest prints. Trade prints and guess what made each one.

items.text: Ridges, veins, and toes print best

scenes.narration: Shells with ridges, leaves with thick veins, and toy feet with clear toes make the sharpest prints. Trade prints and guess what made each one.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child the whole time. If you make plaster casts, only an adult does the plaster. It can get hot as it hardens, so never press a hand into it.

items.text: Adult-only plaster; it can get hot
